verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents its own LLM-based structured extraction as an alternative to CSS and XPath. Its CLI accepts a plain-language query such as "Extract all product prices", so no pre-written selectors are needed. The evidence shows the user stating the extraction goal, but not the LLM itself deciding which fields to pull, and every source is a one-line feature mention. Missing for 10: documentation of the LLM choosing the field schema on its own, in-depth docs on LLM extraction behavior and output, independent hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an LLM read a page and decide what structured fields to pull out without pre-written selectors

citations.quote: Parse repeated patterns with CSS, XPath, or LLM-based extraction.
LLM-Driven Extraction: Supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary) for structured data extraction.
